title: No physicists on NASA's follow-up UAP study

tellings.quote:
my wife and I
were approached to help with the UAP.
NASA was doing their own UAP thing

plain: When NASA ran its own follow-up study of UAP in 2023 and 2024, no physicists were on it, according to Charles Buhler, whom the show bills as a NASA chief. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's current term for UFOs. Buhler tells Michels that he and his wife "were approached to help with the UAP" because "NASA was doing their own UAP thing", and if he is right, the agency studied the question without the people best placed to judge the physics of what is seen.
